title: Slovakian Mushroom Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish, these mushroom dumplings are a hearty and comforting meal. Serve hot with your favorite sauce.
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
2. In a bowl, mix together the dough and water until a smooth dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
4. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
5. Roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
6. Place a tablespoon of mushrooms in the center of each sheet.
7. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
8. Bring the pot of water back to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
9. Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the dumplings float to the surface.
10. Drain the dumplings and serve hot with your favorite sauce.
11. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
